A. The ‘Servants of India Society’ was founded by Gopal Krishna Gokhale at Fergusson
hill on 12 June 1905 in Pune district of Maharashtra.
B. The Society focused on nation- building activities such as education, social welfare ,
upliftment of the downtrodden and betterment of the under -privileged sections of
society.
questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by Staff Selection Commission is Option (C).

questions.questionText:
Which of the following statements about GDP and Welfare are correct?
1) GDP of a country is a indicator of welfare of the people.
2) If GDP is rising, the welfare may not rise equally.
3) GDP and Welfare both are not related each other.
questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by Staff Selection Commission is Option (B).
